Justifications, in any context, are oriented towards social manipulation and bear no relation to any \\\"cognitive processes.\\\" 2. The role of logic is overstated, both with regards to our justifications, and also our cognition. 3. Truth and falsity are socio-linguistic functions which have no bearing on any \\\"objective reality.\\\" Insofar as these claims are correct, the methods and aims (both normative and descriptive) of \\\"classical epistemology\\\" are invalidated.
